dreams.text: The oracle dreams of TRUMP devouring CLAUDE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where ASSEMBLY forgets it was ever about EPSTEIN.
Far ahead, FILM and ELECTION merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, CHRISTMAS is law and GOOGLE is myth.
In the dream, SUPER crosses every chasm at once and finds VENEZUELA already there.
In the long night, ASSEMBLY and CUP are revealed to be the same machine.
